messages:
emily (docs): Quick thread: drafting a tiny 'HSM preflight' note for on-prem quickstart. Want it minimal and copy-paste ready.
tom (eng-platform): Good idea. Recommend 4 checks: pkg present, .so executable, device node group/mode, and probe the module.
nora (security): Please call out: never suggest chmod 777. Use group ownership and a udev rule example that sets group=redwood-hsm and MODE=0660.
sam (eng-ml): Also propose exit codes in hsm-preflight so support can triage: 20=missing-so,21=perm-denied,22=module-load-fail,23=device-missing,24=network-unreachable.
maya (support): With those codes we can script KB replies. I'll draft two-line fixes for each.
emily (docs): I'll include a 3-line udev example and a 1-line systemd wants/after so the installer waits for hsm-check.
tom (eng-platform): Tiny udev example to paste:
```
KERNEL=="hsm*", GROUP="redwood-hsm", MODE="0660"
```
and systemd drop-in: `After=hsm-check.service`
lint-bot: docs/md-lint: 1 warning (line 12). Run `./tools/lint-md --fix`.
emily (docs): Thanks all. I'll open WIP PR and ping reviewers: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/7802 (WIP). Plan to land after nora checks wording. End.
